PdD.source: p0_scales/material_scales.py; Antonov et al., Phys. Rev. B 80,134302 (2009), quoted stoichiometric reference
PdD.status: published reference cell, not newly relaxed DFT

TiD2.status: existing specified initial cubic scenario, not a consumed converged DFT lattice constant

LiD.source: Knudson, Desjarlais and Lemke, Shock Compression Experiments on Lithium Deuteride Single Crystals (2014), p9, measured a=4.072(3) Angstrom
LiD.status: published XRD reference; mean natural Li mass 6.94 amu is a separate approximate isotope choice

thermal.host_status: declared harmonic thermal-width estimates; not fitted Debye-Waller measurements
thermal.fuel_status: PdD published phonon peak via p0_scales; TiD2 and LiD are explicit representative harmonic assumptions, not sourced measurements
thermal.formula: u^2=hbar^2/(2 M epsilon) coth(epsilon/(2 kBT)); epsilon_T=epsilon_D sqrt(M_D/M_T)
thermal.interpretation: independent Gaussian positional disorder around stable ideal crystallographic sites, including zero-point variance

electron_density.formula: rho_j(r)=exp(-r/b_j)/(8 pi b_j^3), projected and Gaussian-thermally convoluted before trajectory sampling
electron_density.source: H hydrogenic 1s density b=a0/2; host lengths are coarse Slater-effective-valence radial-scale estimates
electron_density.status: superposed normalized atomic effective stopping densities, NOT a DFT/PAW valence density or calibrated charge-transfer model
electron_density.mean_normalization: each species local stopping factor has cell mean one; each coefficient is its own bulk atomic stopping cross section

stopping.electronic: g4_beam/transport/bca.py se_ls: Lindhard-Scharff, factors Pd1.54, Ti1.52, H0.75; Li uses documented default1.0, not an invented existing target
stopping.nuclear: same bca.py ZBL potential and cm_angle; discrete recoil tied to each angular kick, not a second added Sn loss
sources: Ziegler, Biersack and Littmark (1985), The Stopping and Range of Ions in Solids
stopping.calibrated_energy_domain: Pd/Ti electronic factors were anchored around5-10keV/u; velocity-proportional ICRU model is low-energy, below10keV/u (~20keV D lab). 50 and200keV lab are uncalibrated LS extrapolations. Li has no range calibration at any energy.
stopping.profile: uniform infinite-thickness stoichiometric crystal in a half-space; no adsorbed sheet or transported depth profile
stopping.reference_profile: homogeneous historical PdD0.70 and TiD1.70, identical between stochastic reference and forward uniform Target; never substituted for production stoichiometry

nuclear.DD: existing forward reaction='proton': fixed threshold resonance in D(d,p)T, Bosch-Hale D(d,n)3He; Ue=0 on both orientations and random
nuclear.DT: Bosch-Hale rational D(t,n)alpha S-factor; target mass changed to T for recoil, phonon width, and Ecm; projectile remains D
nuclear.low_energy_extrapolation: same smooth formula to10eV lab; explicitly below fitted range; no DT copy of DD resonance
nuclear.velocity: lab beam velocity from projectile D mass; Ecm=Mtarget/(Mprojectile+Mtarget) Elab, not Elab/2 for DT

beam.incidence: uniform transverse impact area, independent Gaussian angular components each sigma=polar_rms/sqrt(2)
beam.charge: one incident monoenergetic D+, no molecular fraction, no detector or cup factor

dropped: correlated host/fuel vibrations and electronic bonding/charge transfer
comparison_contract: yield and energy-return ratios use the same isolated reaction channels, Ue0, uniform profile, half-space boundary,10eV cutoff and electronic extrapolation on numerator and denominator
